schedules.name: Daily plan
schedules.prompt: Good morning. Write today's plan for me: look at the task board (list_tasks) and any open goals, then give me the 3 most important things to do today, what each bot should work on, anything waiting on me (reviews, approvals, decisions), and one thing I should learn today as a future lead. Keep it short.

schedules.name: Weekly review
schedules.prompt: Write my weekly review of the last 7 days: what we achieved, the decisions and why they matter, what I learned, and my growth areas as a future lead (be specific and honest). Then add exactly 5 review questions that test what I should remember, each with `add_lesson` (topic "weekly-review", the question and its answer in `lesson`, `review_today: true`).

group.title: Lead Room
group.purpose: The whole team in one room. Agent A moderates: bring a question or idea here and Agent A pulls in the right specialists.
